sections.title: Heavy rod fishing
notes: Items required: Fishing bait or feathers, a knife

steps.text: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him about heavy rod fishing.
chat: 2. What can I learn about the use of a fishing rod?

steps.text: Search the barbarian bed to obtain a barbarian rod.
Catch a leaping fish at one of the nearby fishing spots.
Dissect the leaping fish with the knife to obtain roe. Keep the roe for later.
Talk to Otto again and tell him of your success.
chat: 2. I've fished with a barbarian rod!

steps.text: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him about barehanded fishing.
chat: 1. Please teach me of your cunning with harpoons.

steps.text: Go to any fishing spot that requires a harpoon.
Talk to Otto again and tell him of your success.

sections.title: Lighting fires with a bow
notes: Items required: Any standard bow made with logs, one set of oak logs

steps.text: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him about firemaking.
chat: 3. I'm ready for your firemaking wisdom. Please instruct me.

steps.text: Use the logs on the bow. See the table for skill requirements.
Talk to Otto again and tell him of your success.
chat: 3. I've set fire to logs with a bow!

sections.title: Pyre ships
notes: Items required: Any woodcutting axe, some logs, and a tinderbox or suitable bow

steps.text: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him about firemaking again.
chat: 3. I have completed firemaking with a bow. What follows this?

steps.text: Kill mithril dragons until one of them drops a set of chewed bones (3/128 drop rate).
Construct a funeral pyre at one of the pyre sites using the logs. Light it on fire.

sections.title: Bare-handed planting
notes: Items required: Any seed (except grape seeds) that can be planted with a seed dibber (bring multiple in case you crush the first seed), 1 free Farming patch.

steps.text: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him about farming.
chat: 4. How can I use my strength in the ways of agriculture?

steps.text: Go to the farming patch and plant the seed you have.
Talk to Otto again and tell him of your success.
chat: 4. I've planted seeds with my fists!

sections.title: Pot-smashing
notes: Items required: A spade, any sapling, 1 free Farming patch.

steps.text: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him about farming again.
chat: 4. Are there any other fist related farming activities I can learn?

steps.text: Go to the farming patch and plant the sapling you have.
Talk to Otto again and tell him of your success.
chat: 4. I've smashed a pot whilst farming!

sections.title: Smithing
notes: Items required: Two bronze bars, two logs, and a hammer

steps.text: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him about spears.
chat: 1. Tell me more about the use of spears.

steps.text: Use one of the bronze bar and logs on the nearby barbarian anvil. Make only one bronze spear.
Ask Otto about spears again.
chat: 1. Tell me more about the use of spears.

steps.text: Ask Otto about hastae.
chat: 1. What of the one-handed spears of which you spoke?

steps.text: Use the other bronze bar and logs on the nearby barbarian anvil. Make a bronze hasta.
Ask Otto about hastae again.
chat: 1. What of the one-handed spears of which you spoke?

sections.title: Herblore
notes: Items required: A normal attack potion (2 doses), roe, and a knife.

steps.text: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him about herblore.
chat: 2. What was that secret knowledge of herblore we talked of?

steps.text: Right-click "Use" the roe on the attack potion.
Talk to Otto again and tell him of your success.
